Due to regulatory restrictions, there is no permissible direct inspection route between Depot Alpha and Depot Beta.  
Furthermore, due to alternating maintenance schedules, exactly one of the following two connections must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the link between Depot Beta and Depot Gamma, or the link between Depot Gamma and Depot Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal-distance closed-loop inspection tour that visits every depot precisely once before returning to the origin depot.
